title: Invertibility of one ordinary evaluation diagonal block
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], open U, cochain complexes P,F of module sheaves on U and integers n,r, suppose the canonical module evaluation F^(r+n) tensor Hom(P^r,O_U) to Hom(P^r,F^(r+n)) [lem-pc-finite-projective-internal-hom-evaluation] is invertible. Then the ordinary evaluation component [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data] at p=r+n,q=-r, total degree n, and Hom source degree r is invertible. No bound on either complex is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08DQ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex, last two displayed sums and the final finite-free/direct-summand evaluation calculation; Tag 08DM, lemma-Rhom-strictly-perfect, finite sum versus product calculation

proof_origin.place: Tag 08DQ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex, last two displayed sums and the final finite-free/direct-summand evaluation calculation; Tag 08DM, lemma-Rhom-strictly-perfect, finite sum versus product calculation

proof.text: In degree -r of Hom(P,O_U[0]), the factor indexed by r is the only potentially nonzero factor. Its projection, followed by internal Hom of the single-complex degree-zero unit isomorphism, is invertible by the product universal property.

By naturality of tensor-Hom adjunction, braiding, associativity and the unit action, the component is tensor of that projection followed by the canonical module evaluation. Its degree transport is an identity. Tensor preserves isomorphisms and the hypothesis makes evaluation invertible.
